about.title: About Promos 2011
paragraphs: Promos 2011 gathers the 40 promo cards from 27 products released in 2011: Duelist Pack Collection Tin 2011, Duel Terminal 5, Extreme Victory Sneak Peek Participation Card, Generation Force: Special Edition, Generation Force Sneak Peek Participation Card, Hidden Arsenal: Special Edition, Shonen Jump Scholastic Edition Vol. 9, Issue 1 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 9, Issue 1 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 9, Issue 3 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 9, Issue 4 promotional card, Shonen Jump June/July 2011 subscription bonus, Shonen Jump Vol. 9, Issue 6 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 9, Issue 8 promotional card, Shonen Jump December 2011 subscription bonus, Shonen Jump Vol. 9, Issue 10 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 3D Bonds Beyond Time DVD promotional card, Photon Shockwave Sneak Peek Participation Card, Samurai Assault, Storm of Ragnarok: Special Edition, Storm of Ragnarok Sneak Peek Participation Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus promotional cards, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Qualifier National Championships 2011 prize cards, Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series 2011 Prize Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Volume 1 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Volume 6 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Volume 7 promotional card and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Volume 9 promotional card.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 40 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 45, adding the 5 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
